title: The installed capability contract describes the MIDI headers it claims

installed_sdk.rationale: No installed header, target, or exported symbol changes here. The two headers whose fingerprints moved are changed elsewhere in this branch; this row only reconciles the contract that describes them, so the contract stops disagreeing with the tree.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No CLI verb, flag, or handler is added or changed. The registry and catalog are read by a repository gate, not by a shipped command.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP tool definition or handler is added or changed. Nothing under tools/mcp reads the capability registry.

live_product_control.rationale: No capability, operation, executor binding, or profile policy changes. Nothing a live product can invoke is added, removed, or re-gated.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: docs/status/agent-capabilities.json is byte-identical: the same 111 capabilities, none added, removed, or re-keyed. What moves is the public-surface ledger — two header digests and the inventory version — which records which headers exist, not which capabilities are published. pulp/midi/message.hpp graduates out of the frozen legacy baseline into REVIEWED_HEADERS as infrastructure with no capability keys, because a frozen digest must never be restamped to match an edit; all 337 frozen rows stay intact and the reviewed entry shadows the stale one.
